generatedCommentsNodes.comment: These test cases cover scenarios where no format or content type is provided. Ensure that these tests accurately reflect the expected behavior of the system under these conditions.
This added comment provides clarity on the purpose of the `retrieveMediaType` method. Ensure that this method handles all edge cases and default values appropriately.

The moved comment and the new method `checkDelimiter` are logically consistent with their original placement. However, ensure that the logic for checking the delimiter parameter is correctly applied in all relevant scenarios, especially considering the asynchronous nature of some requests.
The changes in media type handling are consistent with the logic described. However, ensure that the default media type is correctly applied when no media type can be determined from the request.

The renaming of `esqlQuery` to `esqlQueryOrId` and the corresponding updates in logging statements are consistent. However, it is unclear from the context whether all usages of `esqlQueryOrId` will always contain either a query string or an ID without ambiguity. Ensure that this change does not introduce confusion about what `esqlQueryOrId` represents in different contexts.

The refactoring of `runEsqlAsTextWithFormat` and related methods to handle both synchronous and asynchronous requests is comprehensive. Ensure that all modes (sync/async) are correctly handled and that the logic for checking keep-on-completion status is accurate.
